target_customer: Physical commodities trading desks (metals, agriculture, energy) that trade in public markets and bilateral OTC deals
problem: Commodity traders must track derivatives positioning, refinery data, storage, trade flows and geopolitics across many sources. Axis builds an AI native layer where a trader deploys models that monitor and analyze markets and strategies.
business_model: B2B software for trading desks, pricing not public
product_category: AI research and trading platform for commodities

founders.name: Eric Zhu
founders.background_notes: YC page says he was a quantitative trader; firms not named.

founders.name: Ian Wang
founders.background_notes: YC page says both founders worked in quant trading at multiple firms, unnamed. A third party profile mentions internships at Virtu Financial and Akuna Capital, unverified.

competitors.name: Sparta Commodities
competitors.what: Market intelligence and analytics for commodity traders using AI and data science
competitors.funding_then: Series B of $42M led by One Peak announced February 2025, after a $17.5M Series A

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs integrating many commodity data feeds and building monitoring models traders trust. Standard engineering with hard data and finance domain parts.

defensibility.rationale: Two person team with no named customers. Workflow lock in could grow, but data vendors and established players like Sparta already serve the buyer.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent response found as of the search.

market_need_then: Physical commodities are a third of global goods exports per the company, and the YC page describes trading desks needing faster analysis across fragmented data. No dated spend figures found.

branding.domain_note: Company uses axisanalysis.com, not axis.com. YC slug axis-2 shows the plain name was taken.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic common word shared with many companies (Axis Robotics, Axis Communications); no brand coverage found.

outcome_analysis: Axis is an Active Winter 2026 YC company of two ex quant trading founders targeting commodities desks. No verified funding, customers or press were found, so the outcome is open. Risks are a generic name, a small team and established analytics vendors such as Sparta.
notes: A single aggregator (neuronfeed) lists a January 2026 seed of $500K from Y Combinator; unverified and not recorded as a round. Company website fetch returned only the title. Founded year not found. Founder prior firms are not named by the YC page.
